claims.text: When there is a loss of control link, AC 107-2A states to "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft."
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If the connection cannot be reestablished, AC 107-2A instructs to "start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link."
claims.quote: start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: AC 107-2A notes that if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should "follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS."
claims.quote: follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

claims.text: There is no specific time interval for interruption of VLOS; AC 107-2A also indicates the remote PIC may need to land, hover, or employ a return-to-home sequence when VLOS is interrupted.
claims.quote: no specific time interval exists in which interruption of VLOS is permissible

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that, before flight, the remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people, reinforcing preparedness for loss of control link.
claims.quote: The remote PIC must conduct a control link check prior to operations over people.

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if Finish Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will initiate RTH upon completing the mission.
claims.quote: During automated flight missions, if Finish Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will initiate RTH upon completing the mission.
conditions: Finish Action is set to Auto RTH

claims.text: If Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will trigger RTH after the Autel Enterprise App displays the warning message: Aircraft disconnected.
claims.quote: If Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will trigger RTH after the Autel Enterprise App displays the warning message: Aircraft disconnected.
conditions: Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH

claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.

reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

text: FAA guidance: AC 107-2A requires attempting to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, to start emergency procedures; if VLOS cannot be regained, follow pre-determined procedures for loss of VLOS; there is no specific time interval for VLOS interruption, and the remote PIC may land, hover, or initiate RTH; a control link check is required before flight. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: Finish Action Auto RTH triggers RTH after mission completion; Signal Loss Action Auto RTH triggers after disconnection, with continued reconnect attempts and automatic return if the link is restored within 10 seconds. Incident reports (unverified): ASRS notes loss of control shortly after takeoff and reports that all RTH attempts failed.
